bullets: Architected a Django-based distributed workflow platform using Celery, Redis, and LangGraph to orchestrate parallel data ingestion, analysis, and report generation pipelines, reducing portfolio report turnaround from 3–4 hours to under 60 seconds.

Designed a monthly Apache Iceberg partitioning strategy on AWS S3 for 20+ years of financial data, reducing partitions from 7,000+ daily to approximately 240 monthly (~97% reduction) while lowering metadata overhead and preserving month-range pruning.

Engineered a Kafka-based ETL pipeline ingesting large-scale financial datasets into MinIO object storage, processing data across 30+ topics and 1,000+ partitions to support downstream analytics and AI workloads.

Developed and fine-tuned a DeePixBiS-based passive face liveness (anti-spoofing) model for KYC verification, trained on approximately 20K images, achieving 92% validation accuracy under data-constrained conditions, and deployed optimized ONNX Runtime inference endpoints on Hugging Face for real-time evaluation.

Built observability and performance monitoring dashboards with Prometheus and Grafana for an ONNX Runtime-based liveness detection service, analyzing inference latency across 1,000+ requests and validating p99 response times under 1 second.
